text_block_list.text:
When I went shopping at the mall on my day 
off, I saw Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross 
walking around.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~ yep, you got it. But this ain't 
just an ordinary shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"This shopping trip makes us feel right at 
home. Go on, Oguri, tell 'em!"
(Grrumble~~)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Whooooa, hey! If you say it like that, 
all we know is that you're hungry!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Good grief, she really is 
hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya see, they're holdin' a Kansai 
goods fair, so the two of us were just 
about to head on over.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...That's how it is. Excuse me, but 
okonomiyaki awaits.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, don't just wrap it up on your own! 
Am I your commentary track or what?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, h-hey... don't run ahead! You're gonna 
get lost again, Oguri~!

And with that, looking hurried, they took 
their leave.

A little while after parting ways with 
Oguri Cap and the others...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The trade fair is quite far. I feel 
like we've been walking for quite a while 
now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Fancy meeting you again. What 
a coincidence in a mall this big.
choice_data_list: Did you get separated from Tamamo Cross?
Did you get separated from Tamamo Cross?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama? Where is... wait, Tama...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Could it be...? —Tama, did you get 
lost...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They might be feeling lonely right now... 
I have to hurry up and find them...!
choice_data_list: Let's check out the local products fair!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Doing that will surely help us 
find it. Let's get going right away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Have you happened to see an 
Umamusume speaking with a Kansai dialect?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Haven't seen them around.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Are you talking about an Umamusume 
who's as fast as me...?

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Well... I really don't know whether she's 
fast or not...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. If you happen to spot it, please 
let me know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I can't find her. Just where on 
earth did Tama go?
(Grrrummmble~~~)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Maybe from searching all over, my 
stomach is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Could that sound just now be...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...I knew you'd be here! Didn't I tell ya 
not to go off on your own?!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, I'm so glad we found you...! You're 
safe...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm impressed you managed to 
find it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Oguri's loud belly rumblin', I'd 
know where she is in a heartbeat even if I 
lost sight of her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see, letting yourself get hungry really 
does pay off.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I mean, don't look at me like you just did 
a good deed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Now that we've met up with Tama 
and our stomachs are empty, let us hurry 
and go eat some okonomiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you join in too, Trainer? Eating 
together with everyone is bound to be fun.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Marching to the beat of her own drum as 
usual, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've worked up an appetite walkin' 
around too, so I'm totally down for that!

Afterward, the three of us went out to eat 
okonomiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. They might have gone on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"However, though I have been heading 
toward the local goods fair for a while 
now, I have been unable to reach it..."

Judging that leaving Oguri Cap to wander 
on her own would be dangerous, I decided 
to take her to the local specialties fair 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank goodness. Look, Tama was 
there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! ...Wait, huh, why are 
you here...?

I explained that I found Oguri Cap 
wandering laps around the hall and brought 
her here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That's on me for takin' my eyes 
off her. Didn't think she'd manage to get 
lost in such a short time...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't beat yourself up like that. Anyone 
can get lost from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, what matters most is that 
you're safe. You're out of danger now."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —You were the one who got lost!

And so, the venue of the Kansai specialty 
fair echoed with the sound of an 
authentic, sharp tsukkomi...
